mentions.name: Untether AI
mentions.description: Upcoming Garmin watch app for chatting with on-device AI models such as Gemini Nano about health metrics or anything else, without needing the phone or internet. Part of an offline, privacy-first suite that turns a Garmin sportswatch into a smartwatch.
mentions.audience: Garmin smartwatch users who want to reduce phone screentime while keeping essential functionality
mentions.source_excerpt: Untether AI (coming soon) - Chat with Gemini Nano (or others) about your health metrics or anything without your phone
